title: Multi-modal dough state transition control method and smart cooking appliance
business_goal: Generate an AI self-filing legal/compliance-ready draft application for a smart bread maker control feature.

applicant_context.actual_r_and_d_basis: Prototype sensor-fusion controller and bench-test log summary.

inventors.name: Inventor A
inventors.contribution: Designed cross-modal confidence-consistency state transition rule.

inventors.name: Inventor B
inventors.contribution: Implemented recipe-specific threshold calibration using batch feedback.

technical_problem: Timer-based or single-sensor dough processing transitions misjudge kneading maturity and fermentation readiness when flour, hydration, yeast activity, and ambient conditions vary.

required_features: Acquire synchronized torque time-series, dough image, VOC, and chamber environment signals.
Extract modality-specific state features from the synchronized signals.
Generate a dough-state confidence vector for kneading maturity, fermentation readiness, over-fermentation risk, collapse risk, and baking-transition readiness.
Permit a process-stage transition only when at least two different sensor modalities satisfy a confidence-consistency condition.
Update recipe-specific transition thresholds using historical batch feedback.
optional_features: Block baking transition when VOC readiness is high but image-derived collapse risk exceeds a threshold.
Generate fallback control for torque plus image when VOC data is unavailable.

technical_effects.effect: Reduces false transition from fermentation to baking compared with timer-only control.
Improves robustness when a single sensor indicates readiness but another modality indicates collapse risk.

embodiments.name: Smart bread maker embodiment
implementation_steps: Collect a synchronized sensor window during kneading and fermentation.
Compute torque slope, image contour stability, VOC change rate, and humidity deviation.
Generate a confidence vector and compare cross-modal consistency.
Select stirring, exhaust, humidity, temperature, ventilation, or baking-start command.
Store batch feedback and update recipe-specific thresholds.
parameters: At least two modalities required for stage transition

similarity_control.real_technical_contribution_summary: Cross-modal confidence-consistency stage transition and recipe-specific feedback update.

ai_legal_compliance_questions: Confirm whether the confidence-consistency rule is distinguishable over full claims of CN120765118B and CN121195989A before AI self-filing authorization.
Confirm whether fallback modality subsets should be claimed broadly or moved into dependent claims for AI self-filing package validation.
